descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Graffiti London takes your spray cans to the streets every writer in the city knows.

FOUR LONDON PLACES
- LEAKE STREET: the graffiti tunnel under Waterloo station. Eighty metres of brick arch already covered in pieces, strip lights down the roof, daylight at both ends, people walking through with their phones out.
- BRICK LANE: a Shoreditch street at golden hour. Paint the roller shutters and the old warehouse wall under the bunting while the Overground rattles over the railway bridge and a red double-decker goes past the phone box.
- SOUTH BANK: the skate spot under the concert hall. Paint the concrete banks, then turn round to the Thames, Big Ben and Parliament across the water and the giant wheel turning beside you. Big Ben strikes, gulls wheel over the river.
- CAMDEN LOCK: the market wharf on the canal. Paint the old yellow-brick market walls beside the lock gates, the iron footbridge and the painted narrowboats, with stalls, a cafe and bunting all around.

THE CITY IS ALIVE
Londoners walk the pavements, chat in pairs, sit on benches and at cafe tables, stop to take photos of the walls and turn their heads as you pass. Trains, buses, river boats and sirens keep the city moving around you.

PAINT IT
Eight CITIVIEW spray cans, skinny, medium and fat caps, 32 stencils including A to Z, real mist and drips on 20 walls of brick, glazed tile, board-marked concrete and steel shutters. Take a photo of your piece and switch places from the menu.
